concerns.text: FR-001 requires computing visual‑complexity metrics for *video meeting background frames*. The task list only defines T019 (Metric Extraction) for static images and does not include any task that extracts frames from video clips or processes video‑derived frames, leaving a gap between the specification and implementation.

SC-003 specifies that the reaction‑time difference between high‑complexity and low‑complexity conditions must be measured against the baseline reaction time. No task in the current list (including analysis phases T036‑T043) explicitly performs this calculation or produces a corresponding derived dataset, so the success criterion cannot be satisfied.
